name: Etsy
summary: Marketplace for handmade and vintage goods.

flows.title: Turn off personalized advertising
steps: Signed in to Etsy.com, go to Your account, then Account settings.
Scroll down to Personalized Advertising under Privacy Settings.
Toggle Personalized Advertising to Off. In the EU it is off by default.
Without signing in, scroll to the bottom of most Etsy.com pages and select Privacy settings in the footer, then toggle Personalized Advertising and select Done.

flows.title: Pause your Etsy Ads campaign
steps: On Etsy.com, go to your Shop Manager.
Under Settings, choose Pause Etsy ads.
